title: Waste of money
text: I ordered to try it out. After receiving the box I immediately cancelled the subscription. I got poop bags 1 toy and 3 "treat" bags that say all natural yet the ingredients are NOT listed on the bag. Expiration date is also 12/31/2023 which scares me. Treats that last that long have to have preservative in it yet the bags say they don't. Your better off buying things separately then getting this box.
label: negative
